verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is open source and self-hostable, giving users control over their own infrastructure and underlying Postgres data, and the Management API lets you list/query all runs (trigger-dev-docs-17, trigger-dev-docs-19, trigger-dev-gh-1). However, there is no documented bulk-export feature or explicit open-format data-portability guarantee for leaving the hosted service. Missing for 10: dedicated data-export/download tooling, documented export formats (CSV/JSON dumps), and independent evidence of a smooth migration-out process.
